summary: Thursday (titles and thumbnails): found why the $1 billion long video's thumbnail isn't clicked and wrote thumbnail rules for every long video; added 5 big-money topics (Apple, Forbes 400, Las Vegas, Spotify, Bezos) to a feed that had 7.
why: Owner note: 4 clicks from 100 impressions on the last long video; the backlog is 1 and the feed had only 7 open topics; how_they_make_money is 9.77x the median (n=5).

findings.title: The long video's thumbnail contradicts its title
findings.detail: 'MILLION? CUTE.' on a $1 billion video, about 10 small things, a calm face, green on green; the hits use one subject, a reacting face and 2-3 words.

findings.title: Apple keeps about 76 cents per dollar of services, 39 per dollar of products
findings.detail: FY2026 8-K: Services $123.3B on $29.4B cost; a 7.8M-view Short proves demand.

findings.title: 590 American billionaires are too poor for the Forbes 400
findings.detail: The cutoff is a record $4.4B; Musk is at $908B.

findings.title: Titles that name the person and the figure win in the niche
findings.detail: 'Salary of Jeff Bezos... $81,840 per year' 914K, 'Jeff Bezos' Net Worth VS. Yours' 21M; our title arm still defaults to plain (owner notification open).

changes.title: Proposal long-thumb-one-subject-matches-title (adopt, high)
changes.detail: Thumbnail rules for long videos; owner notes added as evidence to the voice-pace and glow proposals.

changes.title: 5 topics added to the feed
changes.detail: Apple services (high), Forbes 400 cutoff, Vegas win, Spotify payouts, Bezos salary.
